SELECT now() AS at, userid::regrole::text AS role, queryid, calls, round(total_exec_time::numeric,1) AS total_ms, round(mean_exec_time::numeric,3) AS mean_ms, round(stddev_exec_time::numeric,2) AS sd_ms, rows, shared_blks_hit AS hit, shared_blks_read AS rd, left(translate(query, chr(10), ' '), 170) AS q FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 22
